metaTitle: Custom Flame Resistant Nursing Scrubs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom flame resistant nursing scrubs for your healthcare team. Durable, FR-rated fabrics with your logo. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Flame resistant nursing scrubs provide essential protection for healthcare professionals working near open flames, electrical hazards, or combustible materials. Unlike standard scrubs, these FR-rated garments meet ASTM safety standards while maintaining the comfort and mobility nurses need during long shifts. Perfect for hospital burn units, OR teams, or emergency responders, these scrubs can be embroidered or screen-printed with your facility's logo for a professional, unified look.
heroAltText: A group of healthcare professionals wearing custom flame resistant nursing scrubs with embroidered logos, standing in a hospital hallway.
